text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I just... want to catch up to my "friend"...
That's all... I'm aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's fine... if no one else can see them...
My "friend"... is right by my side...

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
